cross_verification.note_en: No accessible official Tajikistan government source could be read for this slug despite extensive attempts. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs domain mfa.tj — including the Embassy of Tajikistan in the Republic of Korea page (mfa.tj/en/korea/consular-issues/consular-services/standard-visa) and the Embassy in Washington (mfa.tj/en/washington/consular-issues/consular-fees) — returned a TLS certificate error ('unable to verify the first certificate') on every fetch attempt and could not be read. The official e-visa/visa portals evisa.tj and visa.gov.tj are JavaScript-rendered single-page applications that returned only bare page titles ('Tajikistan e-Visa' / 'Tajikistan visa') with no extractable body text via automated fetch, on every sub-path tried. The Embassy of Tajikistan in the UK domain (tajembassy.org.uk) failed DNS resolution outright. No passport-specific (as opposed to visa) official Tajik page was located at all in search results. All numeric figures circulating online for Tajik passport photos (e.g., 35x45mm, 2x2in, white background, 6-month recency) trace back exclusively to third-party commercial photo-service sites (mybiometricphotos.com, ivisa.com, reloadinternet.com, etc.), which are excluded per the truthfulness gate. This slug should be treated as unresearched pending accessible official sourcing — recommend a follow-up attempt with a tool that can bypass the mfa.tj TLS issue or render JS-heavy pages.
